name: Masuda (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Masuda city emblem in purple: an outlined loop of two crossed strokes, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Masuda, a city in Shimane Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 3 November 1981; the emblem dates from 11 March 1953.

features.role: Masuda city emblem — an outlined loop of two crossed strokes, like a stylised character
